title: Crumple
description: Beatles portraits printed on glossy photo paper arrive as crumpled balls on a pale felt table. Throw one into the others, or tap it and it lifts toward you and unfolds flat, its creases left as a lit relief your pointer rakes light across.
intent: One paper mechanic finished to the edge: a procedural crumple that folds a print along its own crease network into a ball and back, so the flat print keeps every fold it has been through.
